title: HackNation Hackathon — Product Sprint & Core Build
detail: Intensive build session at HackNation. Designed and shipped the core product flow end-to-end: ideation, architecture, and working prototype in 3 hours. Team of 3, full-stack Next.js + Supabase.
reflection: When the deadline is real and the stakes are visible, you build differently. No overthinking — just ship.

title: HackNation Hackathon — Pitch Deck, Demo & Presentation
detail: Built the live demo, polished the UI, scripted and rehearsed the 3-minute pitch. Presented to a panel of judges across product, tech, and business verticals.
reflection: Pitch clarity matters as much as the product. One sharp insight landed better than five features.
